remediations.problem: streaming query has no observable checkpoint

actions.description: Set checkpointLocation on writeStream to durable storage
actions.rationale: without a checkpoint the query cannot resume and loses offsets/state
actions.validation: progress.json shows offset commits resuming after restart

risks: changing checkpoint dir restarts the stream from scratch
rollback_notes: restore old checkpoint dir on regression

remediations.problem: checkpoint lives under a temporary/volatile path

actions.description: Move checkpointLocation to durable storage (S3/ADLS), not /tmp or ephemeral disk
actions.rationale: volatile checkpoints are deleted on restart/cleanup

actions.description: Add withWatermark(eventTime, delay) sized to the real lateness distribution
actions.rationale: unbounded state grows forever without a watermark
actions.validation: stateOperator rows stop growing in progress.json

rollback_notes: widen the watermark window if drops appear

remediations.problem: foreachBatch sink - at-least-once semantics by default

actions.description: Make the batch function idempotent: dedupe on epochId/batchId or use merge/upsert keyed writes
actions.rationale: foreachBatch retries re-run the whole batch
actions.validation: kill mid-batch, restart, confirm no duplicates

prerequisites: sink supports keyed upsert or dedup
